description: This file implements the core logic for a DoorBell class, including network socket management, binding, unbinding, and event handling for a doorbell device within the WPEFramework. It defines the Connector nested class responsible for socket operations and the DoorBell class constructor and destructor.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles network socket creation, binding, unbinding, and event handling for the DoorBell device.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a doorbell device with network connectivity, managing its connection point and signaling.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Connector
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket connections and setting non-blocking mode.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::~Connector
methods.description: Destructor closing sockets and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Bind
methods.description: Creates and binds the socket to the doorbell's address, setting socket options and registering for events.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Unbind
methods.description: Unregisters the socket from event monitoring.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle to the socket for event monitoring.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Events
methods.description: Returns the events to monitor on the socket.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events, calling Read() when data is available.

methods.name: DoorBell::DoorBell
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection point and signaling mechanism.

methods.name: DoorBell::~DoorBell
methods.description: Destructor signaling the event to indicate shutdown.
